name: Forward Diffusion: a digit dissolving into noise
description: Blend Gaussian noise into a real digit and view it

data.noteContent:
Forward diffusion is the easy direction: take a clean image and mix noise into it, step by step, until nothing of it is left. This graph does one such step on a real handwritten digit, 28x28 greyscale with values in [0, 1]. After a run, open the Visualize node -- the 7 is still readable under the grain. Lower the Lerp's alpha towards 0 for a later, noisier step; by 0.4 the digit is gone. The TimestepEmbedding to the side is not part of the blend.

前向擴散是簡單的那個方向：拿一張乾淨的圖，一步一步把噪聲混進去，直到原本的東西什麼都不剩。這張圖對一個真實的手寫數字做其中一步，圖是 28x28 灰階、數值介於 [0, 1]。跑完打開 Visualize 節點，那個 7 在雜訊底下還看得出來。把 Lerp 的 alpha 往 0 調，就是更後面、更吵的一步；到 0.4 數字就消失了。旁邊的 TimestepEmbedding 不參與混合。

The real equation is x_t = sqrt(alpha_bar_t) * x_0 + sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t) * noise, weighted that way so x_t keeps the variance x_0 had. A Lerp weights by alpha and 1 - alpha instead: the same blend, simpler arithmetic, and one fixed step rather than a whole schedule.

真正的式子是 x_t = sqrt(alpha_bar_t) * x_0 + sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t) * noise，那樣配權重是為了讓 x_t 保持 x_0 的變異數。Lerp 改用 alpha 與 1 - alpha：混法相同、算術簡單，但只是固定的一步，不是一整條排程。

A U-Net has to denoise differently at t = 5 and at t = 500, so t arrives as a vector rather than a number: a sinusoidal frequency bank, then a small MLP, 32 dims out. Nothing downstream consumes it here -- this branch is the conditioning signal on its own.

U-Net 在 t = 5 和 t = 500 要做的去噪不一樣，所以 t 是以向量而不是數字送進去：先做正弦頻率組，再過一個小 MLP，輸出 32 維。這裡下游沒有人用它 — 這一支只是把條件訊號單獨攤開來看。
